name: NEW BAR CHECK
summary: This EA is a utility tool that detects the arrival of a new bar on the current chart timeframe by comparing the bar count at initialization versus on each tick. It triggers an Alert and displays a Comment when a new bar is formed, but does not open any trades.
summary_zh: 这个EA是一个工具类程序，通过比较初始化时和每次报价时的K线数量来检测当前图表周期上是否出现了新的K线。当新K线形成时，它会触发警报并显示注释信息，但不进行任何交易操作。
strategy_analysis: 该EA不包含任何交易策略，它纯粹是一个新K线检测工具。其核心逻辑是在OnInit函数中记录当前图表的历史K线总数，然后在OnTick函数中持续获取最新的K线总数进行比较。当OnTick中获取的K线数大于初始化时记录的数量时，说明新K线已经形成，此时触发Alert弹窗通知并使用Comment在图表上显示历史K线数和实时K线数。该EA不涉及任何入场条件、出场条件、仓位管理或资金管理，仅作为新K线到达的通知工具使用。这种新K线检测方法在MQL5编程中是常见的基础技术，但当前实现存在一些不足之处，例如只在新K线首次出现时触发一次通知，后续新K线的检测依赖于BarsTotal_OnInt变量的持续更新。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not contain any trading strategy; it is purely a new bar detection utility. Its core logic records the total bar count on the current chart during the OnInit function, then continuously compares it against the latest bar count obtained in the OnTick function. When the bar count in OnTick exceeds the value stored at initialization, it determines a new bar has formed and triggers an Alert popup along with a Comment displayed on the chart showing both historical and live bar counts. There are no entry conditions, exit conditions, position sizing, or money management features since this EA does not execute trades. This new bar detection approach is a common foundational technique in MQL5 programming, often used as a building block for strategies that need to execute logic only once per bar. However, the current implementation has some limitations, such as relying on iBars comparison which may behave unexpectedly during history updates or chart reloads, and it only provides notification without exposing the new bar state for other logic to consume.

parameters.name: BarsTotal_OnInt
parameters.description: 初始化时记录的历史K线总数
parameters.description_en: Total historical bar count recorded at initialization

parameters.name: BarsTotal_OnTick
parameters.description: 每次报价时获取的最新K线总数
parameters.description_en: Latest total bar count retrieved on each tick

pros: 实现简单直观，代码量少易于理解和维护
新K线检测是MQL5编程中非常实用的基础功能，可嵌入到更复杂的策略中
同时使用了Alert和Comment两种通知方式，确保用户能及时感知新K线到达
pros_en: Simple and intuitive implementation with minimal code, easy to understand and maintain
New bar detection is a very useful foundational feature in MQL5 programming that can be embedded into more complex strategies
Uses both Alert and Comment notification methods to ensure the user is promptly informed of new bar arrivals
cons: 使用iBars进行比较不是最可靠的新K线检测方法，历史数据更新可能导致误报
没有提供可被其他逻辑调用的新K线标志接口，仅做通知而不暴露状态
缺少OnDeinit函数清理资源，Comment不会在EA移除时自动清除
cons_en: Using iBars comparison is not the most reliable new bar detection method; history data updates may cause false positives
Does not provide a new bar flag interface that other logic can call; only notifies without exposing the state
Missing OnDeinit function for resource cleanup; Comment will not be automatically cleared when the EA is removed
improvements: 改用更可靠的新K线检测方法，如比较当前K线的开盘时间(iTime)或使用标准的新K线检测类
添加OnDeinit函数以清理图表上的Comment注释，并考虑将新K线检测封装为可复用的函数或类
improvements_en: Switch to a more reliable new bar detection method, such as comparing the current bar's open time (iTime) or using a standard new bar detection class
Add an OnDeinit function to clean up Comment annotations on the chart, and consider encapsulating the new bar detection as a reusable function or class

risk_points: 该EA不进行任何交易操作，不存在资金风险
iBars在历史数据更新时可能产生误报，但不影响交易安全
risk_points_en: This EA does not perform any trading operations, so there is no financial risk
iBars may produce false positives during history data updates, but this does not affect trading safety
